final_sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Attività commerciali e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 115 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D') AND green >= 74 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC

requirements.description: User wants the commercial unit near parks. 'Near' maps to the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26), rounded to 74. Parks are explicitly mentioned, so the green category is activated. No other proximity services were requested.

The user explicitly requires at least 115 sqm of gross floor area, so surface_area is filtered with >= 115. The 15-child capacity is not converted into an area requirement. Energy class, proximity to parks, and the Turin authorization regime are outside the reference columns and are handled by other agents.

Energy class D or better, as explicitly requested by the user. Geographic (Turin, parks), gross floor area (115 sqm), and childcare authorization requirements are outside the scope of this energy agent and are not filtered here.

output.explanation: Filters ESTATES to commercial units (property_type 'Attività commerciali e assimilabili') with surface_area >= 115 sqm, energy_class from A1 to D, green score >= 74, and within 3.0 km of (45.0677551, 7.6824892) using haversine_km on latitude/longitude. Results are ordered by distance from that point, ascending. No comune_code predicate is applied, since the location comes from coordinates only.
